players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.signal: IonQ 8-K: IonQ received final regulatory approval to complete its acquisition of SkyWater Technology, which it calls the largest exclusively U.S.-based semiconductor foundry, with closing planned for July 31, 2026; IonQ says the deal is expected to materially accelerate its quantum computing roadmap and secure a fully scalable domestic supply chain, and SkyWater will continue to serve a full range of customers as a U.S.-based foundry operating as a wholly owned subsidiary under the SkyWater name.
